notes: Source pages: regular-season individual records are pdf p188-193 (printed pages 186-191); rushing p189, passing p190, receiving p191, interceptions and sacks p193. Every digit was checked against 200 dpi crops of the page pictures, not only the OCR.

through_season is 2025: the lists include 2025-season entries (for example Ja'Marr Chase 125 receptions in 2025, Joe Flacco 470 yards on Nov. 2, 2025, careers ending '2021-25') and the guide is the 2026 edition dated 2026-07-19.

The guide prints NO rank numbers: each block is a value column, then the name, then years/date, top 5 per CAREER/SEASON/GAME. Rank here = printed position; tied values share the lower rank and carry tie=true (the guide prints every tied row, so lists run past 5 rows where ties are printed).
Passing yards and TD passes: the SEASON blocks printed as 'SEASON (total)' were used; the separate 'SEASON (average per team game)' blocks were ignored.

Game lists: years holds the numeric date (M/D/YYYY) followed by the printed opponent text; raw keeps the date exactly as printed (for example 'Sept. 16, 2007 at Cleveland'). Opponent names are as printed (Houston Oilers, Tennessee Oilers, Baltimore Ravens, etc.).

Game lists for rushing TDs and receiving TDs have fewer than 3 named rows because the guide prints the third line as 'many times; most recently <player>' (3 TDs); that aggregate line is not a single game and was left out.
Sacks are the guide's 'SINCE 1976' lists (1976-81 sacks unofficial). The Sacks heading sits above a boxed '(SINCE 1976)' subheading on pdf p193.
Spelling kept as printed except typographic apostrophes were written as plain ' (Ja'Marr Chase, Deltha O'Neal). Chad Johnson is printed 'Chad Johnson' throughout.
